name: HappyDeliver Self-Hosted Email Deliverability Tester
free_limit: AGPL-3.0-or-later self-hosted email deliverability analysis software with REST API, SMTP/LMTP test ingestion, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, DNS and spam scoring; no software usage quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Bring your own server, domain, DNS, storage and inbound SMTP port 25 (often blocked by cloud providers). Optional VirusTotal and third-party reputation API services have separate quotas/terms; AGPL network-use obligations apply. No free hosted email sending or infrastructure is included.
